construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored for this isolated build; synthetic fixtures only.

shared_schema.validation: Schema is the shared validator for input, retrieval responses, research handoff and final output. Unknown fields and incomplete provenance are rejected.
shared_schema.input: schema_version, synthetic=true, allowlisted_hosts, urls, retrieval_fixtures. Exactly one fixture per URL; 1..20 URLs; content <=20000 characters and <=200 lines.
shared_schema.source: source_id, requested_url, final_url, retrieved_at with timezone, verbatim content, content_sha256
shared_schema.finding: finding_id, source_id, source_url, retrieved_at, content_sha256, one-based line_number, verbatim text
shared_schema.insight: All finding fields plus sentiment, sentiment_score, sentiment_evidence, severity, severity_evidence, priority_score, requires_attention.
shared_schema.output: status=ok, research envelope, insights, priority_order, method; failures: status=error and error message, exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated URL requests -> fixture retrieval -> validated final URL and timestamp -> content-hashed sources and verbatim line findings.
The sentiment stage validates the entire research envelope and checks every finding against original source lines and hashes before scoring.
Insight records retain every provenance field; final output is validated against deterministic recomputation.

behavior.retrieval: Offline supplied response fixtures; optional injected retrieval callable is validated identically. No network client exists. Exact HTTPS host allowlist applies to both requested and final URLs; no credentials, fragments or non-443 ports.
behavior.extraction: Every nonblank line is one finding in source/input order. Source text is retained, not summarized.
behavior.sentiment: Transparent English lexicon sums; immediate not/never/no flips weight; punctuation interrupts negation. Token offsets and adjusted weights are exposed.
behavior.severity: Highest matching explicit severity term; independent of sentiment. Severity remains conservative even for negated severity terms.
behavior.prioritization: Severity base 300/200/100/0 plus capped negative magnitude 0..99. Severity always dominates negativity. Stable input-order ties. Only negative or non-low-severity findings enter priority_order.
behavior.determinism: No randomness or wall-clock data; supplied timestamps preserved. Repeated input gives identical output.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout. Exit 0 on success and 2 on validation/file errors. Duplicate JSON keys, invalid encodings and non-finite JSON constants are rejected.

excluded: DNS or SSRF protections for arbitrary injected callables

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: exit 0; one valid JSON object with status ok, 6 insights and 4 prioritized findings.
